name: byo-provider
description: Answer chosen loops (main, a subagent, a fork) with a model on your own Anthropic-format gateway by answering turn.step; every other loop stays on Claude. Env is never touched and the Claude credential is never sent to the gateway.

path.title: Profiles folder
path.description: Folder of <name>.conf profiles (url=, token=, model=, effort=off|low|medium|high|max, timeout=seconds); default.conf is used when no name is typed. Read at each gateway request; the token never enters settings.
